makeup.professional_base_system.description: Professional makeup base system - foundation and cheeks
makeup.professional_base_system.contents: BASE: Cool-toned foundation in 2-3 layers. Lavender-grey pigment under eyes faintly visible through color corrector and concealer layers. Fatigue visible beneath coverage. CHEEKS: Dense cool pink blush across cheekbones extended over nose bridge. 2-3 blush layers creating saturated rosy flush.

makeup.professional_base_system_medium.contents: Professional makeup visible in medium framing. Cool-toned foundation with flawless coverage. Lavender-grey under eyes visible beneath concealer. Dense saturated cool pink blush across cheekbones and nose bridge creating rosy flush.

makeup.professional_sparkle_system.description: Professional makeup sparkle system - highlights and glitter
makeup.professional_sparkle_system.contents: HIGHLIGHT: Wet-look dimensional glow on cheekbones, nose bridge, cupid's bow, brow bone, inner eye corners. Each point catches overhead light with bright white specular reflections. GLITTER: Eyelids completely covered in dense pressed glitter (pale pink fine particles). Glitter from lashline to brow bone. Inner corners with chunky silver-white glitter. Lower lashline fully lined with pale pink glitter. Outer corners with gel glitter texture. Under-eye loose glitter 5-8mm below lashes. Brow bone covered in champagne shimmer. Cheekbone highlights topped with champagne micro-glitter. Nose bridge shimmer stripe. Cupid's bow pearl shimmer dot.

makeup.professional_sparkle_system_mediu.description: Professional sparkle and highlight - medium distance
makeup.professional_sparkle_system_mediu.contents: HIGHLIGHTS: Wet-look dimensional glow on cheekbones, nose bridge, cupid's bow catching overhead light with bright white reflections. GLITTER: Eyelids covered in dense glitter (pale pink). Inner corners with chunky silver-white glitter. Glitter under eyes and on brow bones. Cheekbone highlights with champagne shimmer. Nose bridge shimmer. All sparkle elements catching harsh overhead LED with bright speculars.

makeup.professional_detail_system.description: Professional makeup detail system - eyes, lashes, brows, lips, jewels
makeup.professional_detail_system.contents: EYES: Pale pink cream base across lid. Lavender in crease. Iridescent wash with wet sheen. Pressed glitter center lid. Duochrome shadow outer corner (pink-to-lavender shift). Chunky gel glitter over center. Pearl shimmer inner corner. Eyes highly reflective - polished glass with multiple bright reflections like dull mirrors. Glittery multi-point reflections. LASHES: Upper lashes thick with 2-3 mascara coats (clumpy texture). Individual clusters at outer corners. Lower lashes defined. LINER: Black gel on upper lashline with thin wing. Pale pink on lower waterline. BROWS: Filled cool brown with hair-like strokes, brushed upward with gel. LIPS: Cool pink liner slightly overdrawn. 2-3 lipstick and gloss layers with wet glossy dimension. Glitter particles in gloss. Intense shine. JEWELS: Tiny rhinestones at outer eye corners (3-4 per side). Small rhinestones on brow bone (2-3 per side). Micro pearls at inner corners. All catching overhead light.

makeup.professional_detail_system_medium.description: Professional eye and lip detail - medium distance
makeup.professional_detail_system_medium.contents: EYES: Pale pink and lavender eyeshadow with iridescent sheen. Dense glitter on lids. Duochrome shadow at outer corners. Eyes highly reflective - multiple bright reflections like dull mirrors. LASHES: Thick mascara creating dramatic volume. LINER: Black on upper lashline with wing. BROWS: Filled cool brown, brushed upward. LIPS: Cool pink with wet glossy layers. Glitter particles visible. Intense shine catching overhead light. JEWELS: Rhinestones at eye corners and brow bones catching light.
